subject: maths
question: A square of side 6sqrt 2 cm is inscribed in a circle. What is the area (in cm²) of the circle excluding the square (correct to the nearest integer)? (Use π = frac{{22}}{7})
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When a square is inscribed in a circle, Diameter of circle = Diagonal of square.

Diagonal of square = side × √2 = (6√2) × √2 = 12 cm.

Radius (r) = Diameter ÷ 2 = 12 ÷ 2 = 6 cm.

Required Area = Area of Circle − Area of Square = (π × 6²) − (6√2)².

Area = 113.14 − 72 = 41.14 ≈ 41 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 41 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07c4682432cbc36426fec236bf953f96aec6964ee969ddd18ff2de385d9bd66a.png] 

Given: Side of the inscribed square = 6√2 cm

Formula: Area of Circle = πr² | Area of Square = side²

⇒ Diagonal of square = √2 × side = √2 × 6√2 = 12 cm

⇒ Diameter of the circle = Diagonal of the square = 12 cm

⇒ Radius (r) of the circle = 12 ÷ 2 = 6 cm

⇒ Area of the circle = (22/7) × 6 × 6 = 792 ÷ 7 = 113.1428 cm²

⇒ Area of the square = (6√2) × (6√2) = 36 × 2 = 72 cm²

⇒ Remaining Area = 113.1428 − 72 = 41.1428 cm²

⇒ Rounded to nearest integer = 41 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 41 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Circumcircle of a Square

When a circle circumscribes a square of side 'a', the radius (R) is half of the diagonal: R = a√2 ÷ 2 = a ÷ √2.

Incircle of a Square

When a circle is inscribed within a square of side 'a', the radius (r) is half of the side: r = a ÷ 2.

Ratio of Areas

The ratio of the area of an inscribed square to the area of the circumscribing circle is 2 : π.</p
